item.title: Regional land carbon shifts strengthen atmospheric carbon dioxide–land carbon flux coupling
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 10 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02136-5

Changes in the regional contribution to the flux of carbon from land have become more coupled to interannual atmospheric carbon dioxide fluctuations from 1959 to 2022, making land carbon sink variability more detectable, according to models and observations.
